events.title: Brian Boru wins at Clontarf but is killed
events.description: The Irish high king Brian Boru defeated the forces of Leinster and their Norse allies from Dublin and beyond. He was slain in his tent during the battle, and his hard-won supremacy collapsed.
events.html: The Irish high king Brian Boru defeated the forces of Leinster and their Norse allies from Dublin and beyond. He was slain in his tent during the battle, and his hard-won supremacy collapsed.

events.title: Order of the Garter is founded, by tradition on St George's Day
events.description: Edward III created the Order of the Garter, England's senior order of chivalry, around this time, traditionally marked on St George's Day. Its 24 knights still meet at Windsor.
events.html: Edward III created the Order of the Garter, England's senior order of chivalry, around this time, traditionally marked on St George's Day. Its 24 knights still meet at Windsor.

events.title: William Shakespeare is born, by tradition, in Stratford
events.description: Shakespeare's birth is traditionally dated to 23 April; only his baptism on 26 April is recorded. He went on to write some 38 plays and 154 sonnets.
events.html: Shakespeare's birth is traditionally dated to 23 April; only his baptism on 26 April is recorded. He went on to write some 38 plays and 154 sonnets.

events.title: William Shakespeare dies in Stratford-upon-Avon
events.description: Shakespeare died at his home of New Place, aged 52. Seven years later his fellow actors gathered 36 of his plays in the First Folio, preserving many that might otherwise have been lost.
events.html: Shakespeare died at his home of New Place, aged 52. Seven years later his fellow actors gathered 36 of his plays in the First Folio, preserving many that might otherwise have been lost.

events.title: Future president James Buchanan is born
events.description: James Buchanan was born in a log cabin in Pennsylvania. The 15th US president, and the only one never to marry, failed to halt the secession of Southern states in 1860 and 1861.
events.html: James Buchanan was born in a log cabin in Pennsylvania. The 15th US president, and the only one never to marry, failed to halt the secession of Southern states in 1860 and 1861.

events.title: Coca-Cola launches New Coke
events.description: Coca-Cola replaced its 99-year-old formula with a sweeter recipe. Public protest was so strong that the original returned as Coca-Cola Classic 79 days later.
